ModMetaData.name: Rimworld Biosculpter Compat
ModMetaData.author: ErtzFiend
ModMetaData.description:
Stops a biosculpter bioregeneration cycle from removing implants, gene hediffs and psycast hediffs that are part of a pawn's build rather than injuries.
Protected (exact defNames, nothing else): - VPEP_Puppet and VPEP_Puppeteer (Vanilla Psycasts Expanded - Puppeteer) - ControlSublinkImplant, RemoteRepairerImplant, MechFormfeederImplant (Biotech mechanitor implants) - WarprogrammerInterfaceImplant, LTS_ShoulderTurretActive (Integrated Implants) - VRE_SharpTalons (Vanilla Races Expanded - Sanguophage)
These hediffs sit on the brain, torso and hands. When those parts are restorable (for example with BattIePatch: Enhanced Bioregeneration), a bioregeneration cycle treats them like injuries and cures them, which strips the implants, the shoulder turret, the talons or the puppet link (the last causing abasia and a psychic coma).
What it does: - Protects the exact defNames above, only on the pod occupant, and only while a bioregeneration cycle is completing. - Hides them from the pod's "will heal" tooltip on both the vanilla and Enhanced Bioregeneration description paths, so the listed conditions match what actually happens. - Leaves ordinary healing untouched: wounds, scars, missing parts, blood loss, other brain hediffs and every other condition still heal. Medic cycles and removal outside the cycle are unchanged. Implants are not made incurable anywhere else.
Required: Harmony. Optional mods (each protection simply does nothing if its mod is absent): Biotech, Vanilla Psycasts Expanded + Puppeteer, Vanilla Races Expanded - Sanguophage, Integrated Implants, and BattIePatch: Enhanced Bioregeneration (also improves the tooltip). Load after all of them.
Built and tested for RimWorld 1.7 (1.7.5005 rev1082).
